failure_mode_downstream.value: If this bridge is wrong, wave 2 attributes pipeline symbols to motifs that do not contain them and the fusion STILL RETURNS A MATRIX -- a spurious membership is indistinguishable from a real one in the output. DISTINGUISHABILITY from genuine low affinity rests on two measured properties recorded here: (1) coverage is 96.6 percent, so a genuine low-affinity result still touches ~1291 targets, whereas a broken bridge collapses toward 0 or inflates past 1337; (2) 187 targets legitimately carry multiple motif parents, so multi-membership is EXPECTED here and cannot itself be read as corruption -- a check that flagged it would fire on the healthy state. No fused value is asserted.

evidence.instrument: Coverage and multi-parent census over the joined set
evidence.positive_control: The two properties move in opposite directions under the two failure modes, so together they discriminate where either alone would not.
evidence.failure_look: A spurious membership presents as an ordinary affinity value with no error signal.
